metadata.summary: Carlos Alcaraz has admitted feeling burnt out due to being exposed to a lot of commitments before he suffered a lengthy layoff due to an injury sustained in April.
metadata.content: Laver Cup: Carlos Alcaraz felt burnt out due to exposure before a lengthy layoff with a wrist injury | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Laver Cup: Carlos Alcaraz felt burnt out due to exposure before a lengthy layoff with a wrist injury Carlos Alcaraz reveals he "wants to miss tennis sometimes" after feeling burnt out from all his commitments before his injury lay-off; you can watch the Laver Cup at The O2 in London from 25-27 September live on Sky Sports Thursday 24 September 2026 12:13, UK Image: Carlos Alcaraz felt physically and mentally exhausted before he suffered a wrist injury Carlos Alcaraz has admitted feeling burnt out due to being exposed to a lot of commitments before he suffered a lengthy layoff due to an injury sustained in April. The Spaniard, who won the Australian Open title at the start of the year, was forced to miss more than four months from tennis because of a right wrist injury . Alcaraz returned at the US Open where he reached the quarter-finals before losing a five-set thriller to American Ben Shelton , which finished at 3.33am local time. messages.text: Packers booed in Falcons loss as Robinson dazzles

metadata.summary: Bijan Robinson rushed for 194 yards and two touchdowns as the Atlanta Falcons capitalised on the return of quarterback Michael Penix Jr. and dominated the Green Bay Packers 35-14 on Thursday night.
metadata.content: NFL: Green Bay Packers booed in Atlanta Falcons loss as Bijan Robinson and Drake London star | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL: Green Bay Packers booed in Atlanta Falcons loss as Bijan Robinson and Drake London star Bijan Robinson and Drake London combined for 407 total yards of offense as the Atlanta Falcons cruised past the Green Bay Packers following the return of starting quarterback Michael Penix Jr from injury; Week Three in the NFL continues Sunday, live on Sky Sports from 5.30pm Friday 25 September 2026 07:18, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Atlanta Falcons at Green Bay Packers from Week 3 of the NFL season. Bijan Robinson rushed for 194 yards and two touchdowns as the Atlanta Falcons capitalised on the return of quarterback Michael Penix Jr. and dominated the Green Bay Packers 35-14 on Thursday night. Atlanta (1-2) erased an early 7-0 deficit by scoring 27 straight points to take control amid a chorus of boos at Lambeau Field. The Falcons outrushed the Packers 242 yards to 17. Green Bay (1-2) lost a home opener for the first time since falling 30-22 to the San Francisco 49ers in 2012. The Packers had won 13 straight home openers from 2013-25 to share the NFL record with the Miami Dolphins, who also won 13 in a row from 1976-88. messages.text: Scheffler edges final-hole thriller as Team USA grab Presidents Cup lead

metadata.summary: Team USA made a solid start to their bid for an 11th consecutive Presidents Cup victory by building a 3-2 lead in Thursday's fourballs session against the International Team.
metadata.content: Presidents Cup: Team USA lead International Team 3-2 after Thursday fourballs as Scottie Scheffler makes winning start | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Presidents Cup: Team USA lead International Team 3-2 after Thursday fourballs as Scottie Scheffler makes winning start Scottie Scheffler and Sam Burns defeated Min Woo Lee and Sungjae Im in a final-hole thriller; Team USA won three of the five fourballs matches to take a narrow lead over the International Team on the opening day; watch day two live on Friday from 7pm on Sky Sports Golf Ali Stafford Senior Sports Journalist Friday 25 September 2026 06:59, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the first day of the 2026 Presidents Cup from Medinah Country Club Team USA made a solid start to their bid for an 11th consecutive Presidents Cup victory by building a 3-2 lead in Thursday's fourballs session against the International Team. Brandt Snedeker's side have historically dominated the biennial contest but were presented with a tough test on the opening day at Medinah Country Club, where the Internationals won two of the five points on offer. World No 1 Scottie Scheffler ended his winless record alongside Sam Burns by edging a final-hole thriller against Min Woo Lee and Sungjae Im, following Justin Thomas partnering rookie Jackson Koivun to a 4&3 win over Corey Conners and Nico Echavarria. messages.text: Warwickshire close in on County Championship title after skittling Leicestershire

metadata.summary: Warwickshire took a big step towards clinching the Rothesay County Championship title after skittling relegation-threatened Leicestershire for 125 at Edgbaston.
metadata.content: County Championship: Warwickshire close in on title after skittling relegation-threatened Leicestershire | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content County Championship: Warwickshire close in on title after skittling relegation-threatened Leicestershire Thursday's County Championship sees Warwickshire move closer to title after bowling out relegation-threatened Leicestershire for 125 at Edgbaston; Warwickshire win would guarantee a first title since the Covid-shortened 2021 campaign, with second-placed Somerset struggling against Surrey Thursday 24 September 2026 20:02, UK Image: Ethan Bamber stars as Warwickshire bowl out Leicestershire for 125 to move closer to County Championship title Warwickshire took a big step towards clinching the Rothesay County Championship title after skittling relegation-threatened Leicestershire for 125 at Edgbaston. Ahead of the first day's play, Leicestershire announced plans to appeal their 27-point deduction for a substandard pitch at Grace Road in last month's win over Glamorgan - a decision that means their Division One fate could remain up in the air until the final round of fixtures this week. Only two of their batters passed 12 in Birmingham, with in-form Ethan Bamber taking 4-42 and former England seamer Chris Woakes claiming 3-20 for the Bears, who closed on 130-4 to lead by five.
